questions.examTip: Structure your description in three parts: what you see, an opinion, and a personal link — this shows range beyond simple description.
questions.modelAnswer:
Sur la photo, il y a une foule de gens qui regardent des feux d'artifice au-dessus d'une rivière la nuit. Les gens ont l'air émerveillés et joyeux. À mon avis, les fêtes comme celle-ci sont importantes parce qu'elles créent un sentiment de communauté et de fierté nationale.

(English translation: In the photo, there is a crowd of people watching fireworks above a river at night. The people look amazed and joyful. In my opinion, festivals like this one are important because they create a sense of community and national pride.)

Useful phrases: une foule de gens; ils ont l'air + adjective; un sentiment de...
questions.question: Describe this photo of a crowd watching fireworks at night near a river. Say what is happening, how people might feel, and give your opinion on festival celebrations.

questions.examTip: Prepare flexible phrases for the unexpected question in advance; you cannot predict it exactly, but a stock structure (opinion + reason + example) will fit almost any topic.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Je préfère Noël parce que j'adore passer du temps en famille.
— C'est une fête chaleureuse avec beaucoup de traditions.
— (Question imprévue) L'année dernière, nous avons décoré le sapin ensemble et j'ai reçu un vélo.


(English translation: — I prefer Christmas because I love spending time with my family.
— It's a warm celebration with lots of traditions.
— (Unexpected question) Last year, we decorated the Christmas tree together and I received a bike.)

Useful phrases: je préfère... parce que; chaleureux/chaleureuse; j'ai reçu

note.summary:
Customs, festivals and celebrations
Key vocabulary
- une fête
- fêter
- un défilé
- un feu d'artifice
- traditionnel

Revision focus
Practise present, past and future forms while discussing customs, festivals and celebrations. Build answers with justified opinions and precise examples.

Exam technique
- Spot time markers and negatives before answering.
- Use parce que/car to justify an opinion.
- Check adjective agreement, verb endings and whether the task asks for French or English.
